sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 1; cnt int := 0; BEGIN IF x = 1 THEN cnt := cnt + 1; END IF; IF x >= 0 THEN cnt := cnt + 1; END IF; IF x > -1 THEN cnt := cnt + 1; END IF; RAISE NOTICE 'cnt=%', cnt; END $$;
note: three independent IFs all true - each increments counter

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v numeric := 3.14; BEGIN IF v > 3 AND v < 4 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'between 3 and 4'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF with numeric variable and compound condition

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v text := NULL; BEGIN IF v IS NULL THEN RAISE NOTICE 'null'; ELSIF length(v) = 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'empty'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'value: %', v; END IF; END $$;
note: IF IS NULL then ELSIF length check on text variable

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int[] := ARRAY[1,2,3]; BEGIN IF array_length(v, 1) > 2 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'long array'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF condition uses array function

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v jsonb := '{"a":1}'; BEGIN IF v ? 'a' THEN RAISE NOTICE 'has a'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF with jsonb ? operator

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN CASE WHEN v > 0 THEN CASE WHEN v > 10 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'very big'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'small pos'; END CASE; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'not pos'; END CASE; END $$;
note: nested searched CASE inside searched CASE

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN CASE WHEN v > 0 THEN CASE v WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; WHEN 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'five'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'pos other'; END CASE; WHEN v < 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'neg'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'zero'; END CASE; END $$;
note: simple CASE nested inside searched CASE

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'if1'; END IF; CASE WHEN v < 10 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'case1'; END CASE; IF v = 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'if2'; END IF; END $$;
note: alternating IF and CASE statements

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'pos'; END IF; CASE v WHEN 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'five'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'other'; END CASE; END $$;
note: IF followed by simple CASE

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 1; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP RAISE NOTICE 'i=%', i; END LOOP; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'not one'; END CASE; END $$;
note: FOR loop inside CASE branch

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 0; BEGIN WHILE x < 3 LOOP IF x = 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; END IF; x := x + 1; END LOOP; END $$;
note: IF inside WHILE loop

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 0; BEGIN WHILE x < 5 LOOP CASE x WHEN 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'zero'; WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'other: %', x; END CASE; x := x + 1; END LOOP; END $$;
note: simple CASE inside WHILE loop

sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'a'; END IF; IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'b'; END IF; IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'c'; END IF; IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'd'; END IF; IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'e'; END IF; END $$;
note: five sequential IF statements all true

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 3; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; WHEN 2 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'two'; WHEN 3 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'three'; WHEN 4 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'four'; WHEN 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'five'; WHEN 6 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'six'; WHEN 7 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'seven'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'other'; END CASE; END $$;
note: simple CASE with seven WHEN clauses and ELSE

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; r boolean; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN r := true; ELSE r := false; END IF; IF r THEN RAISE NOTICE 'r is true'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF result stored in boolean then used in second IF

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 2; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN x > 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'two and pos'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'two other'; END CASE; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'other'; END CASE; END $$;
note: searched CASE nested inside simple CASE branch

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN IF v > 10 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'big'; ELSE IF v > 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'medium'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'small'; END IF; END IF; END IF; END $$;
note: three-level nesting using ELSE IF (two words)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 1; y int := 2; BEGIN CASE WHEN x = 1 AND y = 2 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'both match'; WHEN x = 1 OR y = 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one matches'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'none'; END CASE; END $$;
note: searched CASE with AND/OR compound in WHEN

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 5; BEGIN IF x > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'first'; ELSIF x > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'second'; END IF; END $$;
note: duplicate ELSIF condition (first one wins, second unreachable but valid syntax)

sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF (SELECT true) THEN RAISE NOTICE 'subquery true'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF condition is a scalar subquery

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 5; BEGIN IF x > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'pos'; ELSIF x < 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'neg'; ELSIF x = 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'zero'; ELSIF x >= 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'big'; ELSIF x <= -5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'small'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'other'; END IF; END $$;
note: five ELSIF clauses

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 1; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'a'; WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'b'; END CASE; END $$;
note: simple CASE duplicate WHEN values (first match wins, second unreachable but valid syntax)

sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF true THEN RAISE NOTICE 'true'; END IF; CASE WHEN false THEN RAISE NOTICE 'false'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'else'; END CASE; RAISE NOTICE 'done'; END $$;
note: IF then CASE then statement in sequence

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 5; BEGIN IF x > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'positive value: %', x; ELSIF x = 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'exactly zero'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'negative value: %', x; END IF; END $$;
note: IF-ELSIF-ELSE with format arguments in RAISE

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 5; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'five'; END CASE; IF x = 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'also five'; END IF; END $$;
note: CASE then IF in sequence both matching

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'a'; ELSIF v > 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'b'; ELSIF v > 2 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'c'; ELSIF v > 3 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'd'; ELSIF v > 4 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'e'; ELSIF v > 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'f'; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'g'; END IF; END $$;
note: six ELSIF clauses short-circuit on first match

sql: DO $$ DECLARE v int := 5; BEGIN IF v > 0 THEN CASE WHEN v < 10 THEN IF v = 5 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'five'; ELSIF v = 6 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'six'; END IF; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'ten or more'; END CASE; ELSE RAISE NOTICE 'not pos'; END IF; END $$;
note: IF containing searched CASE containing nested IF-ELSIF

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int := 1; BEGIN CASE x WHEN 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'one'; END CASE; CASE WHEN x > 0 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'pos'; END CASE; IF x = 1 THEN RAISE NOTICE 'still one'; END IF; END $$;
note: simple CASE then searched CASE then IF all in sequence
